finding.title: The dispatch wrapper only populates the origin from self[kUrl] when opts.origin is absent, preserving any...
finding.body: The dispatch wrapper only populates the origin from self[kUrl] when opts.origin is absent, preserving any caller-provided origin. This allows caller-controlled origin metadata to reach origin-dependent interceptors such as cache and deduplication, enabling cross-origin cache poisoning and state leakage.

finding.title: Calling accountManager.getCurrentDeviceId() synchronously on the main thread during scheduled sync blocks on the Rust...
finding.body: Calling accountManager.getCurrentDeviceId() synchronously on the main thread during scheduled sync blocks on the Rust FxA client's internal mutex, freezing the UI whenever another thread is performing an account operation.

gold.summary: Reusing byteBuffer across read iterations causes its position to accumulate across reads rather than reflect only the latest read chunk. As a result, b.advance(byteBuffer.position()) double-counts prior bytes on subsequent iterations, corrupting the native buffer offset and causing request.read() to fail with an IllegalArgumentException.
notes: faulty buffer reuse logic that double-counts position and passes a full ByteBuffer

finding.title: When a draft model has token embeddings but no output head, load_arch_tensors unconditionally duplicates the token...
finding.body: When a draft model has token embeddings but no output head, load_arch_tensors unconditionally duplicates the token embeddings as the output tensor instead of sharing the target model's head. For draft models that share the target's output head (such as Nemotron DSpark), this assigns incorrect weights to the output projection and drops draft acceptance to zero.

finding.title: Server-directed retry delays from Retry-After headers are clamped to DefaultMaxServerDelay (8 seconds). When a server...
finding.body: Server-directed retry delays from Retry-After headers are clamped to DefaultMaxServerDelay (8 seconds). When a server requests a delay longer than 8 seconds, the client retries prematurely before the server-specified wait duration has elapsed.
